{"subject":"Quick hello from Harbor Street","body":"Hi,

It's been a while since we last spoke, and I wanted to check in and see how things are going at Fireworks AI. I'd love to hear what the team has been focused on and what's ahead for you.

If you're open to it, I'd be glad to grab 20 minutes on a call in the next few weeks. Just send over a couple of times that work for you.

Hope all is well,
Sam"}
